checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Rusty round robot with blue eyes in all frames.

must.item: Robot waters sunflower, water reaching plant/soil
must.why: Frame 2 shows a water stream into the pot near the stem, though it is faint.

faults.what: Sunflower is not drooping at the start; it is already upright, so the perk-up arc is weak.
Robot is large relative to the sunflower, not tiny; the watering can changes size and shape between frames.
The can and robot arms morph; the robot's hand placement is inconsistent, and the can appears to be held low and tilted oddly.
Water stream is faint, with few sparkling droplets.
The sunflower does not clearly turn toward the robot; its head faces mostly forward.

summary: A charming Pixar-style clip of a rusty blue-eyed robot watering a sunflower at golden hour, with a happy smile at the end. Weaknesses are the weak droop-to-perk arc, a faint water stream and some can morphing.
